<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a halide and forms a ketone (the forward Friedel‑Crafts acylation). Use acetophenone as a representative product.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1C(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
